content: For multi-worker gunicorn, prefer WatchedFileHandler (Python logging) over plain FileHandler since it detects file replacement by logrotate and reopens; combine with a logrotate config using 'su' directive to fix ownership. copytruncate is a fallback but can lose a few log lines during rotation. Simpler alternative for single-worker/low-traffic hobby apps: journald (systemd captures stdout/stderr) with SystemMaxUse cap, avoiding app-level log files entirely.
